test_cpp_program_success: test a C++ program that reads two integers and prints their sum using CppInputOutputEvaluator
test_cpp_compilation_error: test that CppInputOutputEvaluator detects compilation errors when C++ code has invalid syntax
test_cpp_wrong_output: test CppInputOutputEvaluator to verify it detects wrong output when expected values do not match

test_cpp_runtime_timeout: test CppInputOutputEvaluator with a timeout parameter to verify runtime timeout detection on slow C++ code
